title: holeLocations
body:
## holeLocations

Declare distinct local drill centres as [x,y] millimetres. The owned native sketch fixes marker locations; the consuming Hole owns its drill diameter. Use explicit centres for irregular fastening arrangements. Frames and checked planar attachments are shared with other Body profiles. It cannot form a Pad/Pocket.

Native binding: `Sketcher::SketchObject`. Output kind: `["profile"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `support` | one node | no | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `centres` | Distinct local [x,y] drill centres in millimetres, required and limited to 256. Each marker defines one location; the Hole feature defines drill diameter. Duplicate centres fail planning. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2},"minItems":1,"maxItems":256}` | **required** |
| `origin` | World coordinates [x, y, z] of the block's minimum corner (the Part::Box placement base, its front-left-bottom corner). The block extends from this point in the positive X, Y and Z directions; there is no rotation option. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `plane` | World plane containing the polygon. XY maps sketch u, v to world X, Y (normal +Z); XZ maps them to X, Z (normal along −Y); YZ maps them to Y, Z (normal +X). Choose the plane whose normal is the direction you will extrude along, or, for revolve, a plane that contains the revolution axis (XZ or YZ for the default Z axis). | `{"type":"enum","values":["XY","XZ","YZ"]}` | `"XY"` |
| `frame` | An independent right-handed sketch frame: origin in world mm, perpendicular unit xAxis and normal, with local Y defined as normal cross xAxis. Use this instead of plane/origin or onFace; it remains a native placement rather than a linked attachment. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"origin":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"xAxis":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"normal":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true}}}` | omitted |
| `onFace` | Native planar-face attachment intent, paired with support. Select one extreme outward-facing planar face by semantic direction, anchor and offset; ambiguous or missing faces fail. The persisted native support link follows compatible native support edits. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"face":{"type":"enum","values":["top","bottom","right","left","back","front"],"required":true},"position":{"type":"enum","values":["outermost","innermost"],"default":"outermost"},"anchor":{"type":"enum","values":["projectOrigin","centroid"],"default":"projectOrigin"},"offset":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000,"default":0}}}` | omitted |
